blindcourse.why_p1: Many metaphysics enthusiasts share the same experience: you buy a pile of books, memorize 'strong/weak day master' until it's second nature, and can barely tell 'useful god' from 'taboo god' — but the moment you get a real BaZi chart, your mind goes blank. You can't read it, can't make a call, let alone give valuable advice.
blindcourse.why_p2: Where's the problem? It's not that you didn't try hard enough — it's that the system you learned takes a detour.
blindcourse.why_quote: Blind-School BaZi was originally the livelihood of blind masters walking the streets. It had to be simple, direct, and effective — because a blind master earned his meals with it; miss a reading and there's no food. That survival pressure forced out an extremely efficient logic of destiny reading: no strength/weakness analysis, no detours — straight to the 'work relationship' inside the chart.
